title: Sales
startInventory: Add products and materials, then record purchases or prepare bags to get started.
inventoryIntro: Finished products, raw materials and bag preparation.
productIntro: Stock starts at zero. Type and unit stay fixed after creation.
name: Name
recipeIntro: One raw material in grams and optional packaging per bag.
noMaterials: Add a raw material measured in grams
receiveIntro: Record the total cost paid; average cost and stock update together.
adjustIntro: Enter the actual count and reason. Waste can only reduce stock.
prepareIntro: Preparation consumes material and packaging together. If anything is missing nothing is deducted.
noBanks: Add a bank account in Settings
missingRecipe: Set up a recipe before preparing bags.
settingsIntro: Set up your actual business details and bank accounts for transfers.

errors.E_NOT_FOUND: The record is no longer available. Refresh and try again.
errors.E_INACTIVE: The product is inactive. Activate it before recording movements.
errors.E_STOCK: Insufficient stock or invalid waste count. Check inventory.
errors.E_RECIPE: Check the recipe: active raw material in grams and packaging by piece are required.
errors.E_KIND: Type and unit cannot change after creation.
errors.E_COST: Record a costed purchase or preparation before increasing stock through an adjustment.
errors.E_REVISION: Data changed and has been refreshed. Review and confirm again.
errors.E_DUPLICATE: This confirmation belongs to another operation. Refresh and try again.
errors.E_LIMIT: Amount or quantity exceeds the allowed limit.
errors.E_BANK: Select a valid bank account in Settings.
errors.E_INVALID_PARAMS: Check the fields: whole quantities, nonnegative amounts and at most two decimal places.
errors.E_CANCELLED: Request cancelled. If confirmation was in progress, resolve its status before continuing.
errors.E_INTERNAL: Unable to complete the operation. Check your data before retrying.
errors.E_PRODUCT_NAME: A product with that name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.E_PREPARED_PURCHASE: Bags must be prepared. Record a purchase of raw material and packaging instead.
errors.E_REFRESH_REQUIRED: The operation was saved, but data could not be refreshed. Reload the data before continuing.
errors.E_OPERATION_PENDING: The operation result could not be confirmed. Retry its confirmation before recording another operation.
errors.E_RELOAD_REQUIRED: Data could not be refreshed. Reload the data before continuing.
errors.E_CLIENT: Select an active client for this operation. Payments to inactive accounts remain allowed.
errors.E_CLIENT_NAME: A client with that name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.E_CREDIT: The client has overdue debt or exceeds their limit. Enter the exception reason to authorize this purchase.
errors.E_PAYMENT: Check payment: counter sales require full payment, cash must cover the applied amount, and transfers must match it.
errors.E_CASH_CLOSED: Open the cash register before recording cash transactions. Use the button in the top bar.
errors.E_CASH_OPEN: The cash register is already open. Close the current session before opening another.
errors.E_CASH_DIFFERENCE: Explain the difference between expected and counted cash.
errors.E_CART: Review the current sale: add valid products without duplicate lines.
errors.E_TOTAL: The total changed. Review the updated amount before confirming.
errors.E_BALANCE: Payment must be greater than zero and must not exceed the outstanding balance.
errors.E_RETURN: Check quantities: only sold items not already returned can be returned. Opening balances have no products.
errors.E_REVERSE: This payment cannot be reversed: check whether it belongs to a counter sale, opening balance or was already reversed.
errors.E_REFUNDED_PAYMENT: This payment is linked to refunds. Reversal is blocked to keep balances consistent.
errors.E_PERIOD: Check the date range and filters before querying history.
errors.E_BACKUP_FORMAT: The file format, version or structure is not supported.
errors.E_BACKUP_LIMIT: The backup exceeds 20 MiB or supported data limits. No data was truncated.
errors.E_BACKUP_REFS: Backup references, quantities, costs or balances do not reconcile. No data was changed.
errors.E_BACKUP_CHANGED: The file changed after validation. Select and validate it again.
errors.E_BACKUP_EXPIRED: Validation expired or was replaced. Select the file again.
errors.E_BACKUP_HISTORY: This history cannot be preserved faithfully. No data was changed.
errors.E_BACKUP_COST: The last cost cannot be preserved faithfully with a representable rational basis.
errors.E_BACKUP_CLOSING: A closing does not match its cash movements.
errors.E_BACKUP_COPY: The previous copy could not be created or verified. Current data is preserved.
errors.E_PATH_NOT_GRANTED: The file does not have a valid permission for this action. Select it again.
errors.E_PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission to access the file was denied.
errors.E_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the size limit; Sales supports up to 20 MiB.
errors.E_BACKUP_SOURCE: The prepared file can no longer be read. Select and validate it again; no data was replaced.

savedPreviousDraft: The previous operation was saved. The changes shown in this form were not submitted. Close the form before recording another operation.
clientIntro: The payment term applies to new purchases. Existing due dates remain unchanged.
startClients: Register a client to sell on credit and view their account.
paymentIntro: {{name}} · balance {{balance}}. Payment is allocated to the oldest purchases first.
openingBalanceIntro: Record an actual prior balance and its due date. This creates no fictitious products, merchandise sales or cash receipts.
openCashIntro: Enter the opening cash float. Transfers are recorded separately from physical cash.
closeCashIntro: Expected cash: {{amount}}. Count physical cash and explain any difference.
expenseIntro: An expense reduces available funds and does not change inventory.
withdrawalIntro: Owner withdrawals are recorded separately from business expenses.
purchasesSeparate: Purchases remain inventory and are separate from business expenses.
cartDoesNotReserve: Inventory is deducted only when the sale is confirmed.
counterCashOnly: Counter sale · payment must cover the full total.
clearCartIntro: Only the current cart will be cleared. Confirmed sales and transactions are retained.
confirmSaleIntro: Review client, products, payment and balance before confirming. The sale and all related transactions are saved together.
creditExceptionIntro: The client has overdue debt or exceeds their limit. Record the exception reason; this is not administrator authentication.
returnIntro: To return all remaining items, keep the proposed quantities. Outstanding debt is reduced first; any already paid excess is refunded. The original sale is retained.
reverseIntro: The original payment and allocations are retained. Related debt is reopened and a cash outflow is recorded in the current register session when applicable.
selectClientStatement: Select a client to view their statement.
noConfirmedSales: No confirmed sales match this filter yet.
statementPageNotice: Browse all purchase, payment and return pages. The balance includes the complete history.
noHistoricalBank: Bank details are not available for this view.
historicalPaymentUnavailable: Initial payment details are unavailable in this record.
historicalThanksUnavailable: No thank-you message was configured for this record.
ticketOriginalPreserved: The original sale is retained; returns and reversals are shown separately.
draftNotConfirmed: Unconfirmed · inventory and balances have not changed.
profitExplanation: Estimated profit: net sales minus cost of goods, expenses and losses. Purchases and withdrawals are separate; account payments do not create sales.
returnDetailIntro: Original lines for this event; the sale and its historical products are preserved.
backupIntro: Export all Sales data or restore a native or Web 1 backup. Maximum file size: 20 MiB.
restoreWarning: All Sales data will be replaced. A downloadable copy of the current data will be saved before confirmation.
backupStale: Data changed. Select and validate the file again before confirming.
backupPrivacy: The file contains customer and banking information. Keep it outside this computer and share it only with authorized people. Recovery replaces data; it does not merge it.

backupMissing.business: Some historical business information is missing. Tickets will show it as unavailable.
backupMissing.client: Some historical customer names are missing. Current names will not replace them.
backupMissing.clientDetails: Only the historical customer name is available, not all contact information.
backupMissing.received: Original cash tendered is missing for some sales.
backupMissing.change: Original change is missing for some sales.
backupMissing.initialPayment: The initial payment cannot be identified with certainty. Tickets will not invent an original bank account.
backupMissing.bank: Some historical bank snapshots are missing. Current accounts will not replace them.
backupMissing.correctionOrderUnknown: The global order of some older corrections is unknown. Original amounts and reconciled balances are preserved.
